IS 7193 : 2013 : Glass Fibre Base Bitumen FeltsICS 91.100.10CED 41Reaffirmed 20231. ScopeThis standard covers the requirements of self finished glass fibre base bitumen felts for use in water-proofing and damp-proofing.2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
